\noindent Each equation below is a design artifact at its declared epistemic and implementation state. No equation is presented as a validated law of affective response.

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.35em,itemsep=0.72em]
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-001 --- definitional.} Equation~\ref{eq:moment-record}. Names the consent-bounded information available for one individual at one decision point; it is not a fixed representation of the person.
  \textit{Implementation: implemented mock slice. Prohibited inference: The tuple does not reveal a true emotion, diagnosis, need, or successful outcome.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-002 --- definitional.} Equation~\ref{eq:context-store}. Separates consented source events, replaceable projections, and their versions and provenance.
  \textit{Implementation: implemented mock slice. Prohibited inference: The partition does not prove privacy, truth, retention compliance, or correct interpretation.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-003 --- proposed operationalization.} Equation~\ref{eq:working-projection}. Derives the minimized working view permitted by the active consent grant for one declared purpose.
  \textit{Implementation: implemented mock slice. Prohibited inference: A projection is not permission to use excluded, expired, revoked, or out-of-purpose context.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-004 --- proposed operationalization.} Equation~\ref{eq:effective-knob}. Makes current user direction authoritative over accepted suggestions and neutral defaults.
  \textit{Implementation: unavailable. Prohibited inference: A knob value does not directly control acoustics, emotion, usefulness, or benefit.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-005 --- proposed operationalization.} Equation~\ref{eq:mixin-smoothing}. Low-pass filters ordinary normalized control changes to reduce jitter while leaving stop, revocation, and exclusion immediate.
  \textit{Implementation: unavailable. Prohibited inference: Control smoothing does not establish musical, waveform, or emotional continuity.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-006 --- definitional.} Equation~\ref{eq:semantic-condition}. Combines typed semantic mixins under explicit conflict, exclusion, and priority rules.
  \textit{Implementation: formalized only. Prohibited inference: Typed composition is not raw text concatenation or evidence of perceptually linear mixing.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-007 --- proposed operationalization.} Equation~\ref{eq:adapter-compilation}. Compiles a model-independent journey into a capability-bounded adapter conditioning state and then an optional native prompt.
  \textit{Implementation: formalized only. Prohibited inference: Compilation does not guarantee control adherence, model quality, or felt response.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-008 --- estimated model.} Equation~\ref{eq:belief-state}. Represents alternative provisional state hypotheses conditioned on authorized observations and prior controls.
  \textit{Implementation: unavailable. Prohibited inference: The belief distribution is not the person's true inner state, an objective need, or a diagnosis.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-009 --- conceptual.} Equation~\ref{eq:receding-horizon}. Transfers constrained receding-horizon comparison to short, inspectable journey proposals while retaining human approval.
  \textit{Implementation: unavailable. Prohibited inference: The equation does not model a person as a known plant or establish stability, optimality, or intervention benefit.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-010 --- proposed operationalization.} Equation~\ref{eq:buffer-deadline}. Requires verified playable audio to cover observation, planning, generation, verification, scheduling, and uncertainty time.
  \textit{Implementation: unavailable. Prohibited inference: Meeting the inequality does not establish musical continuity, subjective fit, or real-time performance before measurement.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-011 --- proposed operationalization.} Equation~\ref{eq:semantic-continuity}. Measures bounded change between adjacent typed semantic conditions.
  \textit{Implementation: unavailable. Prohibited inference: Semantic proximity does not guarantee perceptual linearity, smooth audio, or desired emotion.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-012 --- proposed operationalization.} Equation~\ref{eq:acoustic-continuity}. Combines normalized boundary distances for measured musical and acoustic features.
  \textit{Implementation: unavailable. Prohibited inference: A low aggregate distance does not prove semantic coherence, seamlessness, safety, or benefit.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-013 --- proposed operationalization.} Equation~\ref{eq:equal-power-crossfade}. Defines one gain curve for joining two verified signals over an accepted overlap window.
  \textit{Implementation: unavailable. Prohibited inference: A crossfade cannot repair incompatible rhythm, harmony, phrase, timbre, meaning, or emotional pacing.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-014 --- definitional.} Equation~\ref{eq:response-record}. Keeps perceived expression, felt response, intensity appraisal, usefulness, harm, resonance, mismatch, and aftereffect as separate fields linked to exposure.
  \textit{Implementation: implemented mock slice. Prohibited inference: Intensity, catharsis, completion, or engagement is not automatically success or harm.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-015 --- future empirical model.} Equation~\ref{eq:response-model}. States the future within-person response distribution that would require qualifying exposure-linked observations.
  \textit{Implementation: unavailable. Prohibited inference: No response predictor is fitted, validated, or authorized to steer generation.}
  \item \textbf{ANT-EQ-016 --- future empirical model.} Equation~\ref{eq:personal-update}. Shows a generic future posterior update while preserving evidence and a prior model snapshot.
  \textit{Implementation: unavailable. Prohibited inference: The form supplies no valid likelihood, causal effect, forgetting rule, sample size, or autonomous update authority.}
\end{itemize}
